equity_bridge.item: FY2026 final HK14c + special HK16c dividend paid Aug-2026, after the 31-Mar-2026 balance sheet (price is ex-dividend)
equity_bridge.note: HK$0.30 x 409.262m shares; FY2026 AR p.532 and chairman's statement

historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity CAGR (+2.6% 3yr, +1.8% 5yr) diverges by far more than 30% from revenue (-6.2%) and reported EPS (-0.6% / -7.8%). The revenue decline is the deliberate phase-out of low-margin Consumer Electronics (HK$1,161m in FY2019 to HK$214m in FY2026) while ICE grew from HK$1,252m in FY2024 to HK$1,446m; gross margin rose from 13.6% (FY2022) to 18.8% (FY2026). Reported EPS is depressed by the HK$48.4m Trio AI charge (adjusted FY2026 EPS ~HK39c vs 41.6c in FY2025). Equity compounds slowly only because the payout ratio ran 53-132%. The base path therefore uses low-single-digit growth off a cleaner FY2027 base, not the historical revenue CAGR; the sanity-check's 'growth_too_high' diagnosis (2.6% vs a -1.1% through-cycle revenue CAGR) is the same CE phase-out artefact and was not acted on.
historical_growth.notes: FCF CAGRs are on the owner-FCF series (reported FCF - SBC - interest income): FY2021 108.6, FY2022 -108.8 (working-capital build), FY2023 139.9, FY2024 155.7, FY2025 -74.3 (GPU capex), FY2026 135.8. The 3-year figure starts from FY2023 139.9. SBC is immaterial (0.1-0.3% of revenue throughout), so the owner and reported series differ almost entirely by the interest-income strip, which grew from HK$5.7m (FY2021) to HK$55.2m (FY2024) and is now falling with US rates (HK$40.8m FY2026): the cash pile's income, not the EMS business, drove most of the FY2021-FY2024 reported-FCF growth.

scenario_narratives.base: A cleaner FY2027 base after the CE phase-out: ICE compounds at mid-single digits on the Canada network-access and HPC-cooling customers plus early automotive wins, CE bottoms around HK$150m, revenue grows ~3% a year on average over the decade. EBITDA ex-interest holds at 11% (FY2026 adjusted 11.2%) with cost headwinds offsetting further mix gains; cash tax normalises to 16% as the Vietnam holiday steps down. Capex ~3% of revenue funds the Vietnam floor and tooling. Interest on the HK$1.2bn cash is stripped from the flows and the cash is added in the bridge net of the HK$122.8m dividend paid in August 2026. The terminal is capped at 10x owner FCF, the top of the stock's own pre-FY2026 multiple range.
scenario_narratives.bull: New automotive programmes (super-duty trucks, hybrids) and China+1 wins fill the enlarged Vietnam campus; ICE grows 7% for three years and EBITDA ex-interest reaches 12.5% on operating leverage. The HK$300m capital-return programme executed at today's price retires ~6% of the count below intrinsic value (not modelled, upside). Terminal 11x owner FCF.
scenario_narratives.bear: Loss or de-stocking at the single largest ICE customer plus tariff-driven re-shoring: revenue -10% over two years, EBITDA ex-interest back to 9%, no recovery beyond inflation, and the multiple goes back to its 10-year range (9x owner FCF). The cash pile puts a floor under the shares, which is why even the bear case does not fall far below the cash-adjusted book value.

valuation_philosophy.summary: Valuetronics is a net-cash EMS contract manufacturer whose value splits roughly 45/55 between a HK$1.1bn cash pile (after the August 2026 dividend) and a core EMS business earning ~HK$120-140m of owner FCF a year on a mature 11% EBITDA margin. The model values the EMS flows at a 10% HKD WACC with interest income stripped and the cash added once, holds the share count flat with SBC expensed, normalises capex at 3% after the one-off FY2025 GPU purchase, excludes the FY2026 Trio AI charges as non-recurring, ramps cash tax to 16% as the Vietnam holiday unwinds, and caps the terminal at 10x owner FCF because the stock traded at 1.2-5.1x EV/EBITDA for nine years before re-rating in FY2026. Results are computed in HKD and converted to SGD at 0.16297 (6.136 HKD per SGD). The first pass at the house 13x cap gave a base value ~6% higher; the difference is the price of assuming the FY2026 re-rating is permanent.
key_risks_to_valuation: Customer concentration: a single Canada-based network-access customer drove FY2025-FY2026 ICE growth; top-5 trade receivables ~65% of the book
US tariff/trade policy (Section 122 measures after the IEEPA ruling) on ~62% of shipments to North America, from China and Vietnam plants
Capital allocation outside core EMS: the Trio AI GPU venture cost ~HK$48m in FY2026 and lease payments remain in default; residual GPUs in PP&E may need further write-downs
Cash tax normalisation: Vietnam tax holiday stepping down and tax losses exhausted; a faster ramp than modelled lowers value
Input-cost inflation (resin, connectors, memory, PCBs, crude-linked logistics) and AI-driven component allocation constraints squeezing the 18.8% gross margin
Multiple: the market has paid 1.2-5.1x EV/EBITDA for this business in nine of the last ten years; the model's terminal (~5.7x) and today's price (~7x) both sit at or above that range
FX: HKD/SGD rate moves translate directly into the SGD value; refresh_price.py does not move fx_rate (see memory), so re-derive the rate on each update

sanity_check_note.status: Sanity check trips on fx-corrupted multiples (known scripts/sanity_check.py fx-direction bug: implied multiples off by fx_rate once, historical table off by fx_rate squared, same signature as BS6.SI CNY/SGD). The hand bridge below is the real picture; it showed a genuine, if partial, excess, so one fix pass was applied.
sanity_check_note.hand_bridged_history_hkd: FY-end (31 Mar) SGD closes from BN2.SI_Prices.csv x approximate SGD/HKD by year, against HKD financials, SBC-adjusted on both sides like the script. FY2017-FY2025: P/E 8.7-12.1x (avg 9.9x), P/B 0.9x-1.9x (avg 1.3x), EV/EBITDA 1.2-5.1x (avg 2.6x), P/Sales 0.61-0.88x. FY2026 (post re-rating, S$1.02 at 31 Mar 2026, reported NI depressed by Trio AI): P/E 21.7x, P/B 1.71x, EV/EBITDA 7.1x, P/Sales 1.51x.
sanity_check_note.implied_multiples_before_fix: At the first-pass base IV (HK$6.10, 13x terminal cap): P/E 21.7x on reported NI / 15.9x on adjusted NI, P/B 1.71x, EV/EBITDA 7.6x, P/Sales 1.51x. EV/EBITDA and P/Sales were above every pre-FY2026 year; the 13x FCF cap implied ~7.3x terminal EBITDA, i.e. the FY2026 re-rating held in perpetuity.
sanity_check_note.fix_applied: exit-multiple cap: terminal_cap_multiple 13 -> 10 (base), 14 -> 11 (bull), 12 -> 9 (bear). 10x owner FCF is ~5.7x terminal EBITDA at the modelled 57% FCF/EBITDA conversion, the top of the stock's own FY2017-FY2025 EV/EBITDA range. WACC premium rejected (would double-charge the concentration/tariff risk already carried by the 25% bear weight; adaptations rule f). Growth cap rejected (the -1.1% through-cycle revenue CAGR is the CE phase-out; base growth already decelerates to 2% and averages 2.75%). Mid-cycle FCF not needed (capex normalised at 3% removes the FY2025 GPU purchase; FY2026 owner FCF of HK$136m is in line with the FY2019-FY2026 average of HK$114m once the two working-capital/GPU years are included).
sanity_check_note.implied_multiples_after_fix: At the post-fix base IV (see valuation.base.intrinsic_value_hkd): P/E ~14.9x on adjusted NI (~20x on Trio-depressed reported NI), P/B ~1.6x, EV/adjusted EBITDA ~7.0x, P/Sales ~1.4x, essentially the multiples the market itself is paying at current_price. Terminal exit inside the historical range; the remaining gap between the implied spot multiples and the pre-FY2026 history is the re-rating the market, not the model, has granted (ex-cash P/E on adjusted NI net of after-tax interest income is ~11x, inside the 8.7-12.1x range). Expect the script to keep printing a trip on the fx artefact until the direction bug is fixed; the hand bridge is the record.

data_sources.price: Yahoo Finance chart API at inputs.price_as_of; 52-week range S$0.81-1.21
data_sources.fx: Yahoo Finance SGDHKD=X at 2026-10-30T21:26Z, cross-checked against the HKD/USD peg
data_sources.financials: BN2.SI_Metrics.csv (FY2011-FY2026 annual, H1 FY2016-H1 FY2026 interim, HKD millions) derived from the SGX annual reports; FY2026 Annual Report (year ended 31 March 2026) for the Trio AI reconciliation (p.457-575), balance sheet (p.3422), EPS/dilution (note 11), leases (note 14(a)), shareholdings statistics (p.6635); BN2.SI_Prices.csv for the sanity hand bridge
data_sources.qualitative: BN2.SI_Analysis.json (2026-10-31); FY2026 chairman's statement and business outlook (capital-return programme, revised 50-70% payout policy, FY2027 outlook)

inputs.share_count_basis: Fully diluted: 409,262,027 shares in issue excluding 26,368,810 treasury shares at 31 March 2026 (FY2026 AR p.6635) plus 1,952,251 weighted dilutive share options (note 11). Held FLAT because SBC is expensed in the flows; the FY2027 buyback (not less than HK$80m) is value-neutral in this model and is recorded in buyback_cash / notes rather than as a falling count.
inputs.sbc_source: FY2026 AR consolidated statement of changes in equity, 'Share-based payments' HK$1,765k (FY2025: HK$1,507k); no equity-award taxes disclosed (net-share settlement not used, options are exercised for cash from treasury shares)
inputs.fx_note: Model currency HKD, quote currency SGD. fx_rate is HKD->SGD = 1/6.136 = 0.16297 (Yahoo SGDHKD=X 6.136, 2026-10-30T21:26Z); per-share values are computed in HKD and multiplied by fx_rate to reach SGD, matching dcf_engine's direction. Direction check: the SGD quote in current_price times 6.136 gives a market cap of ~HK$2.4bn on 409.3m shares against NAV of HK$3.60/share (chairman's statement), a P/B of ~1.6x, plausible. Peg cross-check: HKD/USD 7.80 fixed, USD/SGD ~1.27 -> 7.80/1.27 = 6.14, ties. No dual listing exists for a parity check. refresh_price.py does not move fx_rate; re-derive it on each update.
inputs.wacc_rationale: Built in HKD, the currency of the flows. HKD is pegged to USD, so the risk-free rate is the HK 10-year Exchange Fund Note (~3.8%); ERP 6.0% (mature-market 5.0% plus ~1pp Hong Kong/China country premium); unlevered beta ~1.1 for a small-cap EMS contract manufacturer -> cost of equity ~10.4%. No debt, so WACC = cost of equity, rounded to 10.0%. Customer concentration (top-5 receivables ~65%), US tariff exposure and the Trio AI capital-allocation record are charged ONCE, in the bear scenario and its 25% weight, not as a WACC premium; the same WACC is used in all three scenarios. The sanity-check's 'wacc_too_low' diagnosis was considered and rejected for that reason: stacking a premium on top of the bear weight would charge the same risks twice.
inputs.lease_treatment: No adjustment required. All leases (Huizhou and Phu Tho land) were fully prepaid at inception, so there are no lease liabilities (FY2026 AR note 14(a)); right-of-use depreciation of HK$1.0m sits inside reported D&A and total_debt of 0 is bonds and borrowings only (nil). Ongoing land-use renewals are inside the 3% capex driver.
inputs.nci_treatment: Nil at 31 March 2026: Trio AI was deconsolidated in October 2025 when the Group's stake was diluted from 55% to 26.6% and the associate was written to zero. FY0 flows are attributable-only; no NCI deduction in the bridge.
inputs.notes: MODEL: owner-FCF DCF, component route, with the non-US/cyclical adaptations (HKD flows vs SGD quote; interest income stripped because net cash of HK$1,214m is ~9x the FCF base; SBC near zero at 0.11% of revenue, kept explicit; no leases or NCI to charge). Routed via dcf-methods SKILL.md: an EMS contract manufacturer is an operating company, non-US and cyclical. OWNER FCF: reported FCF 178.416 (OCF 225.410 - capex 46.994) less SBC 1.765 less interest received 40.803 = 135.848. FY0 ADJUSTMENTS: reported FY2026 operating profit 136.8 carries a HK$48.4m net Trio AI charge (45.0 impairment on GPUs and the related lease receivable, 2.2 impairment on loans to Trio AI, 5.3 loss while consolidated, less a 9.4 deconsolidation gain); management's adjusted operating profit is 179.8. Adjusted EBITDA 227.1 less interest income 40.8 (inside 'other income and gains') = 186.3, 11.2% of revenue; that, not the reported 184.1 (11.1% by coincidence), is the anchor for ebitda_margin_path. CAPEX: FY2025's HK$228.0m was ~HK$178m of GPUs bought for Trio AI (the 'other non-current assets' balance at 31 March 2025) plus ~HK$50m for the Vietnam third floor; ex-GPU capex of ~2.9% matches the FY2016-FY2024 average of 2.6%, so the FCF series is not mid-cycled but capex is normalised at 3.0% of revenue (D&A 2.85% rising to 3.0% on the enlarged PP&E base). TAX: cash tax paid of HK$2.8m in FY2026 reflects tax losses now fully utilised; the adjusted effective rate was 10.8% (19.3 / 179.1) and the Vietnam subsidiary's holiday stepped from 100% exemption to a 50% reduction in FY2026 (four years, then the full 20% rate); HK 16.5%, PRC 25%. The cash tax path ramps 11% -> 16% by year 6. WORKING CAPITAL: receivables + inventories - payables = HK$271.7m = 16.4% of revenue, so wc_capture is -16% of the revenue change (growth consumes cash, decline releases it). POST-BALANCE-DATE DISTRIBUTION: the FY2026 final (HK14c) and special (HK16c) dividends, HK$122.8m on 409.26m shares, were paid in August 2026 out of the 31 March 2026 cash; the current price is ex-dividend, so the HK$122.8m is deducted in equity_bridge. Owner FCF earned since 1 April 2026 is not credited (it is inside the year-1 flow). BUYBACKS: FY2026 actual HK$14.3m of treasury-share purchases; the FY2027 programme commits to not less than HK$80m of buybacks plus HK$66m of special dividends, with the balance of the HK$300m programme in FY2028. The count is held flat and buybacks are value-neutral here; executed below intrinsic value they are mildly accretive, which is upside not modelled. TERMINAL CAP (sanity fix pass): see sanity_check_note; terminal owner FCF is capped at 10x base / 11x bull / 9x bear because the stock's own FY2017-FY2025 EV/EBITDA range was 1.2-5.1x and a 13x FCF cap would have capitalised the FY2026 re-rating in perpetuity. SCALE CHECK: filing units HK$'000 converted to HK$ millions (1,660,246 -> 1,660.246). At the price in current_price the market cap is ~HK$2.4bn; EV ex-cash ~HK$1.3bn after the dividend deduction = ~6.9x adjusted EBITDA ex-interest, ~9.4x owner FCF, ~15x adjusted NPAT of HK$159.9m.
inputs.fy0_component_check: FY2026 rebuilt from components: EBITDA 186.3 - SBC 1.8 - D&A 47.3 = EBIT 137.2; tax at 10.8% = 14.8 -> NOPAT 122.4; + D&A 47.3 - capex 47.0 = 122.7; working capital +11.0 (revenue fell HK$68.8m x 16%) = 133.7 vs actual owner FCF 135.8. Ties within 2%.

bear.narrative: The Canada network-access customer that drove FY2025-FY2026 ICE growth de-stocks or dual-sources, Section 122 tariffs push US customers to re-shore or squeeze pricing, and CE keeps shrinking: revenue falls 6% then 4% before flat-lining. Tariff and component cost absorption pulls EBITDA (ex-interest) back to the FY2023-FY2024 9% level with no recovery. Working-capital release cushions the first two years. Terminal cap 9x owner FCF (~5x terminal EBITDA): the stock goes back to its FY2017-FY2025 multiple range. Capital returns continue but no further Trio-AI-style misallocation is modelled; a repeat would be worth ~HK$0.12/share each time. Same WACC: this is the scenario that carries the concentration and trade-policy risk.

base.growth_rationale: FY2027: ICE +5% (Canada network-access customer volume, new automotive programmes ramping late) against CE -25% (management says entertainment-customer growth will not fully offset the legacy phase-out) nets to ~+1%. FY2028-FY2029 +4% as CE stabilises at ~HK$150m and ICE compounds at 4-5% on the enlarged Vietnam floor (+40% space). Decelerates to 2% by year 9, in line with ICE's own 10-year CAGR of 2.5%.
base.margin_rationale: Anchor is FY2026 adjusted EBITDA ex-interest-income of 11.2%. Year 1 10.8% absorbs the tariff, resin/connector/memory and logistics cost headwinds management flagged; 11.0% thereafter as the mix shift is now largely complete (ICE 87%). Record gross margin of 18.8% is held, not extrapolated.
base.tax_rationale: Adjusted FY2026 effective rate 10.8%; tax losses now exhausted and the Vietnam 50% reduction runs ~four more years before the full 20% rate; blended with HK 16.5% and PRC 25% the cash rate normalises at 16%.
base.terminal_rationale: Cyclical, single-digit-growth EMS that traded at 1.2-5.1x EV/EBITDA every year from FY2017 to FY2025 before re-rating to ~7x in FY2026. Terminal owner FCF capped at 10x (~5.7x terminal EBITDA at the modelled 57% FCF conversion), the top of the stock's own pre-re-rating range: the house 13x cap would have assumed the FY2026 re-rating persists in perpetuity. Gordon at 10%/2% would give 12.75x, so the cap binds and terminal_growth is inert in this scenario. Terminal growth 2% (HKD inflation, mature end-markets).

bull.narrative: Super-duty truck / hybrid automotive programmes win on the dual-site IATF 16949 platform, the HPC-cooling and network-access customers keep growing, and China+1 demand fills the new Vietnam floor: ICE grows 7-8% for three years. Mix shift continues and operating leverage on a fixed Vietnam cost base lifts EBITDA (ex-interest) to 12.5%. Slightly higher growth capex. Terminal cap 11x owner FCF (~6.3x terminal EBITDA): a modest, sustained re-rating above the pre-FY2026 range, not the full FY2026 multiple. Same WACC: the extra upside is in the flows.

required_return_table.note: Each row rebuilds the terminal value at that row's rate (max(0, min(Gordon@r, 10x FCF_N))); the WACC row is valuation.base.intrinsic_value and the hurdle row is entry_price.base.entry_price.

sensitivity.note: Rows are WACC, columns terminal growth; each cell rebuilds its own terminal value.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear raised from the 15% house default to 25% because ICE growth is concentrated in one Canada-based customer (top-5 receivables ~65% of the book), ~62% of shipments go to the US under a still-evolving tariff regime, and the Trio AI episode (HK$48m written off on a non-core GPU venture) shows capital-allocation risk outside the core. Bull cut to 25% because it needs two independent things to go right: automotive programme wins ramping to volume AND a further step up in margin after the mix shift is already largely complete. Base 50%.
probability_weighted.band_note: House and street coincide (SBC immaterial): the band collapsed, so band_position is null rather than a degenerate 0.

sanity_check.basis: SBC-adjusted on both sides (EPS less SBC/share; EBITDA less SBC), so these deliberately do not match GAAP screener multiples.

diagnosis.detail: Structural risks in the qualitative analysis that a standard WACC may not price: customer concentration, cyclicality, regulatory single point of failure
Projected growth 2.6% exceeds the through-cycle revenue CAGR -1.1%
